Name: Shed with Cellar
Author: Quody
Description:
This is a remake of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3484]"Bigger Shed/Shed with Cellar"[/url] by Spotteddotted for 1.6. It also has some added features like decorating the walls and such.

You will probably want to empty your shed before you upgrade, if not then some stuff in the top left may be out in the void.

Let me know if you find any bugs and I'll see about fixing them. The only thing I couldn't get working the same was the brick flooring in the cellar, but you can fix that by replacing the flooring like normal.

This replaces the upgraded shed, so base shed is still a small square, this felt more balanced to me.

This mod will be removed if requested by Spotteddotted.
